'''Gambo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] criminal who lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and could only be reached through his [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] guard [[Zooki]]. [[Police officer/Legends|Police Officer]] [[Anstiss]] of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] was assigned the task of arresting Gambo. Though he beat her up several times, she was able to complete her task with the help of a Republic individual.<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Gambo appears in the ''Cantina Contusions'' mission for a Republic character in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The character can choose to convince Gambo to turn himself in, arrest him, or kill him.<ref name="TOR" />
